data.overview: A trusting country girl is deceived into a sham marriage by a wealthy seducer. Cast out after bearing his child, she struggles to make a new life in a society that judges her for his betrayal.
data.tagline: A simple story for plain people.
data.title: A Plain Girl's Promise
